subject: Claim-maintenance wave 3: visible-text deltas over 77 public claim pages, wave 2 to wave 3

payload.authority_for: a dated re-read of 77 public claim pages, comparing the sha256 of their visible text between two waves
payload.extractor: sha256 over the visible text of each page, capped at 400000 bytes, read twice 30s apart
payload.transport_note: Node fetch. councilof.ai answers 200 here and 403 to urllib under the Cloudflare rule `public-data: no BIC`; the estate's own urllib builders read as "unreachable" for that reason.
what_this_does_not_establish: Whether any claim is true. A re-read says what was served today, not what is correct.
Whether a change was material. A text change is a candidate material change; the adjudication is a human call.
Any promotion of the claim-maintenance axis. That axis is a declared slot with no run behind it and stays UNMEASURED.
A ranking, a grade, a status or an approval of any subject.

unmeasured: whether any changed text is material; the adjudication is a human call and no third party is named from a delta
